From the moment I arrived, the lady at reception was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful.

I visited to receive my Meningitis vaccination ahead of my upcoming Umrah trip to Saudi Arabia. Not only were their prices extremely reasonable compared to other clinics, but the level of care was outstanding.

Dr. Y. Rashid was fantastic, professional, friendly, and compassionate. When it came time to pay, I realised I didn’t have any cash on me. Remarkably, Dr. Rashid simply said not to worry and kindly suggested that my wife could make the payment at her upcoming vaccination appointment, trusting me without hesitation. I was truly touched by this gesture, especially as we are not even registered with the practice.

A vaccination certificate was also promptly issued.

Overall, I highly recommend Shifa Medical Practice. Excellent service, compassionate care, and genuine integrity. Dear reception

I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction with the registration process and overall service at SHIFA Medical Practice.

On multiple occasions, I attempted to register with the practice via the NHS website and their own online portal—a process I undertook four to five times without success. Additionally, on the 17th of August, I visited the practice in person, submitted all required documentation, and completed the necessary forms. I was assured that my registration would be processed promptly.

Moreover, I provided two letters from my doctors in Portugal, detailing the need for specific medical tests, which I have been awaiting for three weeks. Unfortunately, I was informed today, the 29th  of August, that my documentation has been misplaced.

When I contacted the practice on the 28th of August to address my concerns, the receptionist suggested that I consider registering with another clinic if I was dissatisfied with their service. This response is unacceptable and has further exacerbated my frustration.

I have escalated this matter to the NHS and am awaiting a resolution. To date, I remain unregistered and deeply dissatisfied with the level of service provided. I believe that every patient deserves respectful and efficient service, and my experience has been far below acceptable standards.

I trust that this matter will be addressed promptly and that appropriate action will be taken.

Sincerely,
